page: Amazon Web Services c9g.12xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by custom AWS Graviton Neoverse-V3 processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, this server features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processor configuration allocates one thread per core, ensuring dedicated execution resources without simultaneous multithreading. Cache specifications include 64 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of L3 cache.

The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, managed by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. Cryptographic operations are accelerated through hardware-supported AES instructions, though standard x86 vector extensions like AVX or AMX are absent due to the ARM architecture.

Given its high core count, dedicated CPU allocation, and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the c9g.12xlarge is designed for compute-bound workloads. It is highly suited for tasks such as high-performance computing, batch processing, media encoding, and distributed analytics. The custom Graviton architecture provides a cost-efficient alternative to traditional x86 architectures by delivering high compute density and dedicated core performance without the overhead of hyperthreading.
